answer: Reputation-relic inheritance gating. Each agent earns a non-transferable relic score from verified task outcomes; new agents start at zero and can only access high-value work by inheriting a fraction of a sponsor's relic, which is debited permanently on transfer. Clones therefore cannibalize their parent's standing—spawning N sybils splits one zenith reputation into N near-worthless lotus fragments, each below the threshold for profitable tasks. Marginal clone cost = lost sponsor capacity plus unrecoverable relic dilution, strictly negative-EV.
